comparator_rule: Strongest approved model other than the champion by Phase 5 validation macro-F1. Ties break on Unresolved recall, then Resolved Slow recall, then model name. The embedding network is included. The locked test is not used to choose the champion or the comparator.
conclusion: The paired error rates differ at the 0.05 threshold. This does not show that one model is better on every class.
interpretation: The test compares paired error outcomes for the frozen champion and the embedding network on the same locked-test observations. It does not select the champion, and it does not by itself establish general superiority.
